title: Update from the previous release without legacy readers

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage

**Caught.** The maintained installer journey caught a regression that rejected an unchanged installation of the immediately previous numeric release.

- **Story and revision.** `SEED-423#retire-finished-migrations-and-legacy-formats` at `8ed7250e2d0dd93afd6eb995f02152f1e8452ae7`. The checked example in `.planning/seeds/SEED-423-shrink-the-installed-distribution.md` permits ordinary update from `0.1.2` to `0.1.10` when those tags are the previous and latest releases.
- **Fault.** In `release_baseline_candidates` in `Distribution/src/install/open-dough-release-baseline.sh`, I temporarily used `latest_version` alone as the supported minimum. The unchanged fixture provided `0.1.1`, `0.1.2`, and `0.1.10`.
- **Independent observation.** A separate tab-bearing scratch target had both installed roots at `0.1.2`, with `compare-payload` verifying each against the tagged payload before the update. Ordinary `apply` exited 1, said installed `0.1.2` was older even though it named `0.1.2` as the previous release, and left both roots at `0.1.2`.
- **Maintained observation.** On AC power I ran `/opt/homebrew/bin/bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/installation/install-all-tools.sh` under `caffeinate -s -i` with Node 24.21.0. The runner recorded the named case as passed, failed, and passed on baseline, faulted, and restored runs, respectively. The faulted run reached the ordinary `apply` at line 239 and its required successful exit failed with the same previous-release diagnostic. The script stopped there under `set -e`, before its later payload and hook assertions. This verdict covers the preceding-release transition.
- **Restoration.** The pre-probe, restored, and cleanup status files matched and were empty. `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` succeeded after restoring the edit. The restored test passed and the scratch worktree was removed. Evidence and this report are in `/tmp/dough-intent-423.mbRMSszc/`.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing preceding-release journey. This probe calls for no additional test or change to a prior disposition.

- **Test runtime.** 69.4 s (measured), summed from the runner's named job times of 28.1 s baseline, 20.7 s faulted, and 20.6 s restored.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human effort measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent time was not measured separately from elapsed time.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 165021 ms (measured), from 1795440021655 to 1795440186676 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Story Wrap Up disposition

At `8ed7250e2d0dd93afd6eb995f02152f1e8452ae7`, the maintained journey caught the injected rejection of the previous release. Keep that journey. No follow-up.
